headline: Nigerian Naira Drops to N1,388 Per Dollar, Reaching Eight-Month Low
summary: The Nigerian naira slid to N1,388 per US dollar in official trading, marking its weakest closing level since March 2026.
why: The naira's foreign exchange rate directly affects import costs, domestic price inflation, and sovereign creditworthiness in Africa's largest economy.

impacts.name: Nigerian Naira
impacts.why: The naira reached its lowest exchange rate against the US dollar in eight months.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Dollar demand imbalances in official foreign exchange channels drove the naira down to multi-month low levels.
